text:
oliver_sales: Heads-up: Northstar Finance is evaluating a full swap from OpenBridge to Redwood. They want a short POC (7 business days) proving functional parity for their KYC & fraud prompts, a filled security checklist (GDPR/data residency emphasis), and a pricing delta vs their current $95k/mo contract. Thoughts?
rachel_se: I can lead the tech POC. Clarify  they need perfect wire-format drop-in or just behavioral parity? Northstar said minimal code changes to their integration.
oliver_sales: They said minimal changes but legal flagged any divergence during A/B must be below a tolerance. Wants ability to toggle back to OpenBridge for fails.
laura_product: Suggest a compatibility adapter + SDK shim for Node/Python that mirrors OpenBridge request keys (request_id, user_ctx, meta) -> Redwood. Also add a runtime flag `compat_mode: openbridge_v3`. We have an internal prototype we can extend.
ben_infra: For the POC we need: 1) EU-hosted staging (they require EU data residency), 2) a scoped API key, 3) IP allowlist entries (they'll run tests from 3 static IPs). I can spin up a single-node dedicated instance in the EU region.
priya_infosec: Security checklist highlights: encryption at rest with customer-managed keys, SCIM provisioning, SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs export, and data processing agreement. GDPR question: do we support EU-only processing for the POC?
ben_infra: Yes — we can provision an EU-only staging tenancy and ensure no logs leave region during the POC. We'll surface specific KMS ARNs for their legal.
laura_product: Parity caveats: tokenization differences and stop-logic are the main causes of small diffs. OpenBridge uses greedy stop trimming and returns n-best candidates. We can provide two modes: `dropin_emulation=true` (attempt close token parity) and `nbest_mode=true` (return n-best). That should reduce A/B noise.
rachel_se: Also note sampling defaults: OpenBridge uses top_k=50, top_p=0.92; they may have tuned it. Ask Northstar for the generator params used in prod.
oliver_sales: I'll request those. Also pricing: if they're at $95k/mo today, we should show three options: Hosted PAYG (est. $78k based on their token usage), Dedicated reserved (estimate $65k/mo with 12-month commit), Private (license + infra, upfront ~$250k + support). I'll draft numbers after they send monthly tokens.
priya_infosec: They sent a short security questionnaire in Docx. I can prefill standard answers in 24h but need confirmation about backup retention windows and subprocessors list. Legal wants subprocessors enumerated.
laura_product: Subprocessors: cloud provider, metrics provider, and CDN. We'll need legal to confirm if any others should be listed.
ben_infra: Ops note: to reduce nondeterminism during parity runs, recommend using deterministic seeds and set `stream=false`. Also provide a replay harness that sets `max_new_tokens` and `temperature=0.0` for comparability.
ci-bot: automated: job "poc-deploy-northstar" queued; estimated infra provisioning time 3h.
rachel_se: Example curl for shim (dev-friendly):
```bash
curl -X POST https://redwood-eu-stg.example/v1/compat/openbridge \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer STG-NS-KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"request_id":"abc123","user_ctx":{"id":"u-1"},"prompt":"check kyc for user...","params":{"temperature":0.0,"top_k":50}}'
```
This maps to Redwood call and returns `nbest` if requested.
priya_infosec: GDPR/deletion flow note: we support immediate deletion endpoints and backups purged within 5 business days for EU staging. Add to answer doc.
oliver_sales: Legal fallback: they want automatic switch to OpenBridge if semantic match < 0.88 on X% of queries. Legal flagged PII forwarding as blocker. We should propose: (A) fallback only on private infra with no forwarding, or (B) redaction pipeline + signer consent.
laura_product: Agree. Recommend option A for initial POC. We can demo fallback in a non-PII flow for now.
ben_infra: Sandbox ready: endpoint=https://stg-eu-northstar.redwood.internal, static_ips=[52.16.1.5, 52.16.1.6, 52.16.1.7], api_key=stg-NS-KEY-xxxxx. Rotate key post-handoff.
priya_infosec: I'll attach the partially filled questionnaire to the shared drive and tag legal for subprocessors. ETA 24h for full answers.
rachel_se: Parity metrics proposal (for SLA discussion): 1) exact-match % on canonical templates, 2) embedding cosine >= 0.89 on intent clusters, 3) manual verification on top 50 high-risk prompts.
oliver_sales: Action list: 1) oliver: collect monthly token numbers + generator params from Northstar (ETA: today), 2) rachel: extend shim & build replay harness (ETA: 3 days), 3) priya: finish security doc + GDPR clauses (ETA: 24h), 4) ben: confirm sandbox & creds (ETA: 3h), 5) laura: prepare fallback demo & parity metric dashboard (ETA: 4 days).
laura_product: I'll also add a CI diff checker that flags token-level deltas > 2 tokens for the smoke set.
priya_infosec: One more: Northstar asked about on-prem possibility for the long run. We support an on-prem deployable bundle (x86+NVIDIA) with customer-managed KMS; procurement/legal will need full BOM and deployment checklist. I'll note that in the questionnaire.
oliver_sales: Great. I'll schedule kickoff for Friday 11am CET once sandbox is confirmed. Please post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
